claim: On Friday 27 November 2026 the Chamber of Deputies passes in third reading the government's "lex Ukrajina" security bill (print 213), which tightens temporary protection for Ukrainian refugees by tying the humanitarian benefit to work, business or job-seeker registration and at least 16 days a month in the country.

runs.scenario: ČTK or ČT24 reports passage within the window on 27 November, but the official roll call is not posted until 28 November. One reader could resolve YES because the criterion expressly accepts same-day reporting; another could withhold YES because the deciding-source clause specifies a same-day psp.cz roll call.
runs.yes_requires: The Czech Chamber of Deputies adopts the final third-reading passage motion on print 213, in any amended form, between 09:00 and 23:59 Prague time on Friday, 27 November 2026. A vote on an amendment alone does not count.
runs.decided_by: The named deciding source is the psp.cz roll call for 27 November labeled “Závěrečný souhlas,” published that day. The criterion also allows same-day reporting by ČTK or ČT24.

runs.yes_requires: The Czech Chamber of Deputies must adopt the final passage motion ('Závěrečný souhlas') on print 213 in third reading, in any amended form, between 09:00 and 23:59 (Europe/Prague) on 27 November 2026.
runs.decided_by: The psp.cz roll call of 27 November 2026 ('Závěrečný souhlas'), or same-day reporting by ČTK or ČT24.

runs.scenario: Print 213 is adopted inside the window and ČTK and ČT24 report that the same evening, but psp.cz does not publish a roll call labeled "Závěrečný souhlas" until 28 Nov, or publishes the final vote the same day under a different heading. One reader counts the media reports or the substantively final roll call as YES; the other treats only a same-day psp.cz "Závěrečný souhlas" roll call as decisive and resolves NO.
runs.yes_requires: Between 09:00 and 23:59 Europe/Prague on 27 November 2026, the Chamber of Deputies adopts the final-passage motion on print 213 (the government bill amending laws on measures connected with the armed conflict in Ukraine), in any amended form.
runs.decided_by: Primarily the psp.cz roll call of 27 Nov 2026 identified as "Závěrečný souhlas" and published that day; the YES clause also cites a same-day ČTK or ČT24 report.
